stories.headline: 53 orangutans were saved from Borneo's wildfires
stories.summary: Forest and peat fires are burning food supplies for critically endangered orangutans. Since August, the nonprofit YIARI has rescued 53, including mothers and infants in critical condition.
stories.why: Many have already been rewilded to safer forests, like Gunung Palung National Park, 5 hours away.

stories.stat_label: tall, a record for its fungus group
stories.headline: Scientists found 'D-rex', a giant new fungus in China
stories.summary: Dianjunus rex grows from the roots of cork oaks and can stand 50 cm tall and weigh 2.2 kg. That beats the old record of 20 to 30 cm, and it needed a whole new fungus family.
stories.why: Its lineage dates to about 65 million years ago, just after the dinosaurs died out.

stories.stat_label: accuracy with 5 qubits running at once
stories.headline: A silicon quantum chip ran 5 qubits at once, accurately
stories.summary: Running many qubits together usually adds errors. RIKEN scientists found a hidden cause and a fix, keeping 5 silicon qubits at about 99.9% accuracy all at once.
stories.why: Silicon qubits can be made like today's chips, a step toward bigger quantum computers.

stories.headline: Engineers built a cloak that hides objects from heat cameras
stories.summary: The 3D-printed aluminium and rubber shell guides heat around what is inside, so infrared cameras see nothing there, from any direction. It even hid shapes like human heads.
stories.why: It could help cool microchips and shield delicate electronics from extreme heat and cold.

fun_fact: D-rex is named after the ancient Dian kingdom of Yunnan, and 'rex' for its king-sized build.
